## Definition of done

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits and names the feature ID
- [ ] Tests added; CI green (lint, strict types, coverage, import contracts)
- [ ] The feature's "done when" criterion is demonstrated (how: …)
- [ ] Docs or ADR updated if behaviour or a decision changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added
- [ ] Model or engine change: backtest score attached and no worse than `benchmarks/`
